Your prayer may be answered inside the disaster.

Kevin Trudeau says every problem holds the seed of a greater benefit. The answer you have been asking the universe for may be hiding inside the calamity.

He says you just have to unpack it, see it as a gift, and be thankful and grateful.

What problem are you facing that might be hiding an answer?
